title: Public Health Analytics-OS indicator metadata-quality profile
appliesTo: Indicator manifestations represented as named JSON objects
interpretation: Metadata completeness and explicitness only. The score is not a rating of indicator validity, source authority, data quality, comparability, computability or fitness for purpose.

dimensions.label: Definition
criteria: definition more informative than a repeated label

dimensions.label: Computation
dimensions.conditionalRule: A source-supported not-applicable statement receives full credit only when consistent with the measure type. Percentage/proportion requires an explicit denominator and multiplication by 100.

dimensions.label: Disaggregation and reporting context
criteria: lowest reporting, administrative or geographic level

dimensions.label: Limitations
criteria: caveats, limitations or explicit evidence gaps

notApplicable.meaning: A justified not-applicable statement is present and consistent with the measure type.

partial.meaning: Metadata is informative but incomplete, label-only or insufficiently specific.

explicitGap.meaning: Absence or uncertainty is explicitly declared without invented metadata.

missing.meaning: The field is absent, null or blank.

invalid.meaning: The value conflicts with a structural or conditional rule and creates a validation issue.

rounding: Round the weighted total to the nearest whole number after retaining unrounded dimension contributions.

legacyFields.metadataLevel: Legacy release/extraction class. Retained for provenance; do not interpret as the computed metadata-quality level.
legacyFields.completeness: Legacy hand-assigned completeness value. Retained for provenance; do not interpret as a score generated by this profile.

publicationRule: New or revised records should carry the profile ID and version with their computed score. Historical records remain auditable through the validation report until entry-level migration under TRUST-05.
